name: Andrew Leick
headline: Electrical Engineering student at Stanford University
summary: Seeking software development roles. Two summers as a Software Development Engineer Intern at Amazon, building systems on AWS.
about: I study Electrical Engineering at Stanford University and expect to graduate in June 2028. I am looking for software development roles.

At Amazon I spent two summers as a Software Development Engineer Intern. In 2026 I built a log correlation platform for on-call engineers, with an ingestion pipeline on AWS Lambda, S3 and DynamoDB, Athena-backed search, a TypeScript UI and an MCP server for AI agents. In 2025 I built an AWS system that centralizes contract storage, with Node.js Lambdas, Amazon Redshift and QuickSight dashboards.

Earlier, as a Software Research Intern at Georgia Tech Research Institute, I programmed a robot to navigate and map an unknown environment with Python and ROS. I was also president and programming/electrical lead of my FIRST Robotics team.
